messages.text: Poch fumes at Yoro red and thinks Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood

metadata.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood.
metadata.content: Mauricio Pochettino: Man Utd boss fumes at VAR in Liverpool loss over Leny Yoro and Dominik Szoboszlai calls | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mauricio Pochettino: Man Utd boss fumes at VAR in Liverpool loss over Leny Yoro and Dominik Szoboszlai calls Man Utd to contact ProRef and the Premier League over 'totally wrong' interpretation of Leny Yoro's red card in loss at Liverpool after call was overturned; Man Utd boss Mauricio Pochettino: "What were VAR doing?"; Poch also believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood Tuesday 24 November 2026 22:05, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Following Leny Yoro's overturned red card for Manchester United during their 4-0 defeat to Liverpool, Mauricio Pochettino questioned VAR's involvement in the Frenchman's dismissal. Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood. Yoro's one-match suspension for the red card he was shown in the 4-0 defeat at Anfield has been removed, despite referees' chief Howard Webb supporting the decision to send him off. Man Utd will contact ProRef and the Premier League directly over what they believe to be a 'totally wrong' interpretation of Yoro's red card against Liverpool.
